Can a Dental Bridge Get a Cavity?

The artificial porcelain tooth itself cannot decay, but the natural anchor teeth underneath the crowns absolutely can. If plaque builds up around the margins where the crown meets the gum, a cavity can form.

Veneers also help protect the front surface of your teeth from further wear or damage.

title.rendered: How to remove Invisalign aligners

content.rendered:
A

How to remove Invisalign aligners

Your aligners are easy to remove. First, make sure your hands are clean and dry. Gently hook your fingertips underneath the inside edges of both sides of the back lower tray. Then move your fingers forward, loosening the sides of the aligner as you go. Finally, lift the aligner up gently to remove it. For the upper aligners, hook your fingers underneath the back portion of each side of the tray, and pull downward and forward gently to loosen the aligners from your teeth and remove them.
